programmes.show_description: Host Jimmy Carr is joined by team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson and guests Johnny Vegas, Vernon Kay, Lorraine Pascale and Henning Wehn.
Jimmy Carr presents as Sarah Millican and Josh Widdicombe take on Alan Carr and Thanyia Moore. The Delightful Sausage join Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner. With Rachel Riley.
Louis Smith, Tony Law, Alice Levine and Carol Vorderman join host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson for this edition of the topical panel game.
Teleshopping
Teleshopping
Bryon Stephens, the president and chief operating officer of Marco's Pizza, goes incognito among his employees to assess how the firm and its franchises are faring.
Greg Adler, the president and CEO of off-road accessory empire 4 Wheel Parts, goes undercover in his own business. But his identity is scrutinised by one canny employee.
...Selling: Frank and Diana live in a million-dollar district, but their fixer-upper's far from being fancy. With four kids and a bird, the twins find them a new nest to call home.
In south London, there are feeding faux pas, raunchy revelations and kitchen catastrophes, as three couples compete to host the best dinner party.
Three couples compete in and around Newcastle, in a week featuring refined dining, an energetic evening, bickering and an eclectic menu.
The One with Joe Swash: What's better than a soap wedding? Nothing, according to Dele, who's organised an EastEnders-themed do for bride Tracy.
The One in the Batcave: Anthony has planned an underground Batcave-like wedding for Lauren, who doesn't like 'the dark' or 'small spaces'. A cave is surely right up her street then.
Jeff Dudan, the CEO of environmental services company AdvantaClean, goes incognito among his staff to ensure that his franchise owners are following his template for success.
John Fuller, CEO of The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf, goes undercover to check on his shops' efficiency. Six years earlier, he did the same thing as CEO of diner chain Johnny Rockets.
Fleming: Gordon Ramsay visits Fleming, a Danish restaurant in Miami. Once the best family-run restaurant in town, it's now losing money fast.
Sushi Ko: Akira and Lisa are losing up to $20,000 a month at their sushi restaurant in California. Can Gordon piece the family back together and save the restaurant?
and Selling: Brand new series: Can the twins turn a leaky bath, outdated features and a purple paint palette into a blank page for Blanca and Teddy?
Grenadian Nightmare: Anthony buckles under pressure. A familiar face shakes up the interior. And Fraser and Barbie's drama threatens to ruin a crew day off.
Chris Ramsey draws the line at dried spaghetti, the comics are shaken and stirred by a big tube, and Judi Love 'impresses' the Taskmaster with her life achievements.
Jimmy Carr hosts as Jon Richardson and Jo Brand take on Joe Wilkinson and Jamali Maddix. Rachel Parris joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner. With Rachel Riley.
...Christmas Special: Jimmy Carr hosts as Jon Richardson and Sarah Millican take on Lee Mack and Jason Manford. With Nick Mohammed, Joe Wilkinson, Susie Dent and Rachel Riley.
St. Hospitals: Mark and Jeremy are at the hospital awaiting the birth of Mark's baby. Sophie wants to have a natural birth and doesn't appreciate Mark's anxiety.
Nether Zone: It's christening day for his baby, and Mark arranges to pick up Jeremy, the baby's godfather, on his way to church. Unfortunately, the lads get locked in a hallway.
Glen tackles Jack's inking, Sketch rids Ben of a silly spooning tattoo, Alice waves her magic wand for Kamila, and Jay fixes Matt's backside-based chat-up line.

Ashley and Brandon Wright, the co-owners of Hamburger Mary's, go incognito in their company, to ensure that their culture of diversity is being maintained as the business grows.
Dan Duffy, CEO of the United Real Estate Group, goes undercover in his own firm. He meets different employees and learns about their professional and personal lives.
...Selling: Nurse Jenna and firefighter Neil need to sell his frat house before they can settle down in their own home. Can the place be revived and smoke out the competition?
In Devon, there's a 'Britalian' mash-up, stomach-churning confessions and generous helpings of criticism, as three rival couples put their hosting skills to the ultimate test.
In Hull, image-conscious Jay and Heather go all-out American. Thrifty Mike and Stef serve a school dinner throwback. And is Steve and Stephanie's fine dining fare a little too fancy?
The Big Fat Nigerian One: Ola's handed over control of her wedding to super-cool groom Raphael, who's looking to plan a gigantic Nigerian wedding for the ages.
The Romeo and Juliet One: Dan plans to prove his romantic prowess by organising a Shakespearean wedding in Italy for Kate. He's hoping for a happier ending than the play he's inspired by...
Mike Roper, the president and CEO of quick-service Tex-Mex restaurant chain Taco Bueno, disguises himself to work among his staff and gain insight before growing the business.
John Carona, CEO of property management company Associa, goes undercover in his own organisation to see first-hand how his employees are dealing with recent changes at the firm.
Lido Di Manhattan: Ambitious graduate Lisa bought her restaurant in California at just 23 but, five years later, she's worried she picked the wrong venture. Can Gordon help?
Anna Vincenzo's: Gordon Ramsay visits Italian restaurant Anna Vincenzo's in Florida, where owner CeCe has lost her way in the kitchen. But can she take constructive criticism?
...and Selling: Brand new series: Paul and Julie are parents feeling the squeeze. As well as wanting to size up, they need to keep their mortgage to a minimum. Can the twins help?
Royal Rumble: Ben's wandering eyes upset Sunny. There's major drama when new guests are royally demanding. And Fraser reaches breaking point with Barbie.
Taskmaster Greg Davies delivers rough justice as Ardal O'Hanlon sings about a fence, Judi Love designs classy headgear, and Sophie Duker displays world-class endurance.
Sean Lock, Bob Mortimer, Harry Hill, Joe Lycett, Jon Richardson, Lucy Beaumont, Katherine Ryan and more take on the words and numbers in this best-bits compilation episode.

A Beautiful Mind: Jeremy tries to impress Zahra by holding a book group, but he's only ever read Mr Nice. Meanwhile, Mark is worried that he can't satisfy Dobby's sexual needs.
New Year's Eve: It's New Year's Eve, and Mark is depressed about Dobby, but Jeremy is determined that the 'El Dude Brothers' are going to enjoy the night of their lives.
